summary.intent: Execute the gsd plan-phase workflow for Phase 45 (desktop FUSE write-durability cleanup) end-to-end, including research, validation artifact generation, security gate assessment, and pattern mapping, before spawning the planner.
summary.outcome: Research (RESEARCH.md), validation scaffold (45-VALIDATION.md), and pattern analogs (45-PATTERNS.md) were all written and committed. The workflow reached the point of gathering planner inputs but the transcript ends before the planner agent was spawned.

repo: Phase 45 is a Rust-only hygiene refactor of FUSE write-journal/replay code with 7 scope items and no behavior change — MVP mode, UI gates, and ORM schema-push gates do not apply.
Security enforcement is on (ASVS L1), pattern-mapper is on, and intel is on for this project's gsd configuration.
The API surface extractor uses a regex that does not cover Rust, so it returned 0 symbols and was skipped when passing context to the planner.
The commit helper script emits a false-negative 'commit_failed' signal even on success when lint-staged output is present; git log is the authoritative check.

code.finding: Created from the VALIDATION.md template with filled frontmatter for Phase 45; committed at 340e93efe.
Pattern mapper found 3 analogs relevant to journal_helpers.rs and the new error variant.

workflow: The plan-phase workflow gates fire in order: phase validation → CONTEXT.md check → research → VALIDATION.md → security gate → pattern-mapper → intel → planner spawn.
When RESEARCH.md already exists and --research flag is not passed, the workflow auto-uses it with a one-line notice rather than re-spawning the researcher.
Always verify commit success via git log rather than trusting the commit helper's return value, which can produce false-negatives alongside successful lint-staged output.

friction: The commit helper returned a false-negative 'commit_failed' status despite the commit succeeding, requiring an extra git log verification step.
The Rust API surface extractor returned 0 symbols because the regex extractor doesn't support Rust, silently producing no intel output with no clear error.
open_items: Planner agent (gsd-planner) has not yet been spawned — the transcript ends at the point of gathering planner inputs.
Verification loop (gsd-plan-checker) and final PLAN.md output are not yet complete.
The API surface extractor should be extended to support Rust so intel context can be passed to the planner for Rust-heavy phases.
